name: Marion Neithart
original_name: マリオン＝ナイトハルト
source:
A Dark Knight Demon.
He has always protected the protagonist since she was a child, he's absolutely loyal to her.
He doesn't care about anything besides the protagonist and doesn't even like interacting with other demons.
